name: Mazzy
shortBio: Mazzy advises individuals, entrepreneurs, business owners, investors, and corporate clients throughout New York and New Jersey on a broad range of legal and business matters.

He began his legal career as an Assistant District Attorney with the Kings County District Attorney’s Office. Before becoming an attorney, he worked as a banker with J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. and as a Financial Planner with Merrill Lynch Wealth Management.

biography.text: Mazzy advises individuals, entrepreneurs, business owners, investors, and corporate clients throughout New York and New Jersey on a broad range of legal and business matters. His practice focuses on real estate transactions, business and corporate law, estate planning, tax planning, commercial transactions, and commercial litigation.

biography.heading: Transactional practice
biography.text: Mazzy represents clients in real estate matters involving the acquisition, sale, development, financing, leasing, and ownership of property. He also advises businesses and entrepreneurs on formation, corporate structuring, contracts, partnerships, shareholder matters, and other business transactions. In addition, he assists individuals and families with estate planning and related tax considerations, with an emphasis on protecting assets and preserving wealth for future generations.

biography.heading: Litigation experience
biography.text: Mazzy brings substantial litigation experience to his practice, having represented corporations, property owners, contractors, engineers, professionals, and other businesses in complex and high-exposure matters in state and federal courts throughout New York and New Jersey. His litigation experience includes commercial disputes, construction and premises liability, contractual disputes, professional negligence, product liability, insurance matters, and other complex business and tort litigation.

biography.heading: A litigation background in transactional work
biography.text: His litigation background provides a valuable perspective in his transactional practice. Having seen firsthand how contractual provisions, business structures, and risk-allocation decisions can lead to disputes, Mazzy approaches transactions with an emphasis on anticipating potential issues, protecting clients’ interests, and developing practical solutions.

biography.heading: Early legal career
biography.text: Mazzy began his legal career as an Assistant District Attorney with the Kings County District Attorney’s Office, where he litigated a diverse caseload from arraignment through final disposition. He later joined a well-respected law firm as a member of its Complex Tort & General Casualty Division.

biography.heading: Banking and financial planning
biography.text: Before becoming an attorney, Mazzy worked as a banker with J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. and as a Financial Planner with Merrill Lynch Wealth Management. His background in banking and financial planning provides an additional business and financial perspective that informs his approach to real estate, corporate, estate planning, tax, and transactional matters.
